# Support

Start with the [troubleshooting guide](../TROUBLESHOOTING.md) and [installation guide](../docs/INSTALLATION.md).

Use the issue tracker for reproducible AegisDNS problems. Include the commit, operating system, architecture, Docker version, deployment method, reproduction steps, and redacted logs. Questions about a proposed feature should use the feature request template.

GitHub issues are public. Never post passwords, bearer tokens, private DNS history, client addresses, `.env` contents, or vulnerability details. Report vulnerabilities through [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/Harshil-Anuwadia/aegisdns/security/advisories/new).

Community support is provided as maintainer time permits and carries no response-time guarantee. Organizations that want to fund maintenance or discuss scoped deployment assistance can read [Sponsorship](../SPONSORSHIP.md).
